{"bugs_found": ["eof uses `index > len(stream)` instead of `index >= len(stream)`, violating the EOF contract: it fails at the true end of stream and succeeds only past the end, breaking `Parser.parse` for fully-consumed input", "Parser.__mul__ with a range uses `self.times(other.start, other.stop - 1)` which makes the max bound `stop - 1`; per contract the max should be `stop - 1` only because range.stop is exclusive — but combined with times() treating max as inclusive this is consistent; however range(0,1) yields times(0,0) which forbids any match, contradicting expected range semantics (still off-by-one relative to typical expectation, but contract explicitly allows). Not a bug per stated contract."], "verdict": "REQUEST_CHANGES"}
